description_en: Queries the virus scan blacklists and whitelists for a specified operating system, and returns the results grouped by matching dimension and list type. The blacklists and whitelists are global lists scoped to the Alibaba Cloud account and operating system dimensions, and take effect for all on-demand scans, scheduled scans, and real-time protection under the account
description_zh: 查询指定操作系统下的病毒扫描黑白名单，按匹配维度与名单类型分组返回。黑白名单是阿里云账号与操作系统维度的全局名单，对该账号下的即时扫描、定时扫描与实时防御全部生效
name: ListVirusScanAdditionalLists

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type for which the list takes effect. Valid values:
windows: Windows.
macOS: macOS
parameters.help_zh:
名单生效的操作系统类型。取值：
windows：Windows系统。
macOS：macOS系统
parameters.name: dev_type

parameters.help_en: Filters by matching dimension. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, all matching dimensions are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按匹配维度过滤，不允许重复。不传则返回全部匹配维度
parameters.name: additional_types

parameters.help_en:
Filters by list type. If this parameter is not specified, both blacklists and whitelists are returned. Valid values:
Blacklist: Blacklist. Files that match are directly identified as virus files.
Whitelist: Whitelist. Files that match are excluded from virus detection
parameters.help_zh:
按名单类型过滤。不传则黑名单与白名单都返回。取值：
Blacklist：黑名单，命中的文件直接判定为病毒文件。
Whitelist：白名单，命中的文件不参与病毒检测
parameters.name: list_type

parameters.help_en: Filters by list entry ID. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by list entry ID is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按名单条目ID过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按名单条目ID过滤
parameters.name: list_ids

parameters.help_en: The content of the list entry, using exact match. This parameter is used to locate a specific list entry by content and does not support fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 名单条目内容，精确匹配。用于按内容定位某一条名单，不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: list_detail

AdditionalLists.description_en: The blacklists and whitelists grouped by matching dimension. If a matching dimension contains no list entries, that dimension does not appear in the list
AdditionalLists.description_zh: 按匹配维度分组的黑白名单列表。某一匹配维度下没有任何名单条目时，该维度不会出现在列表中

items.description_en: The blacklists and whitelists under a specific matching dimension
items.description_zh: 某一匹配维度下的黑白名单

AdditionalType.description_en:
The matching dimension of the list entry. Valid values:
FileSuffix: Matches by file name extension.
FileName: Matches by file name.
FolderName: Matches by folder name.
FilePath: Matches by file path.
FileMd5: Matches by file MD5 hash
AdditionalType.description_zh:
名单条目的匹配维度。取值：
FileSuffix：按文件扩展名匹配。
FileName：按文件名匹配。
FolderName：按文件夹名匹配。
FilePath：按文件路径匹配。
FileMd5：按文件MD5值匹配

Lists.description_en: The lists grouped by list type under this matching dimension
Lists.description_zh: 该匹配维度下按名单类型分组的名单

items.description_en: The lists under a specific list type
items.description_zh: 某一名单类型下的名单

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the list entry, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 名单条目的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

Detail.description_en: The content of the list entry. The meaning is determined by the AdditionalType to which it belongs
Detail.description_zh: 名单条目内容，含义由所属的AdditionalType决定

ListType.description_en:
The list type. Valid values:
Blacklist: Blacklist. Files that match are directly identified as virus files.
Whitelist: Whitelist. Files that match are excluded from virus detection
ListType.description_zh:
名单类型。取值：
Blacklist：黑名单，命中的文件直接判定为病毒文件。
Whitelist：白名单，命中的文件不参与病毒检测
